text:
OncallBot: PAGING: [INC-2026-045] Canary alert - /v1/embeddings 5xx increase in eu-west-1 (now ~12% over last 10m). Routing policy triggered. @oncall-team please acknowledge. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-failures :rotating_light:
Sara Li: acked. I'm on it. seeing spike in telemetry dashboards. pinging infra to check recent canary rollout.
Matt O'Connor: grabbing logs now. which deploy went to eu-west-1 canaries around 03:10 UTC?
Dee Patel: that was a small tokenizer change (tokenizer-refactor) merged earlier today, commit a1b2c3d. It was rolled to canary in eu-west-1 only.
Alex Ruiz: oncall-ingress reports increased request timeouts to the tokenizer service, followed by 5xx from embeddings-worker. correlation looks strong.
Sara Li: @Matt can you validate if KV cache miss rates also spiked? could be cache key change from tokenizer output.
Matt O'Connor: cache miss pct jumped from 2% -> 28% at 03:11 UTC. logs show different prefix tokens for long inputs.
Product Ops: customer impact projection: approx 3% of production requests routed through eu-west-1; for affected customers inbound errors ~1.8% of global requests during window. Need customer comms if this lasts >30m.
Dee Patel: ok i'm preparing a feature-flag kill. flag name `tokenizer-v2-rollout` - we have a one-click kill but the console shows 'partially applied' for eu-west-1. suspect rollout orchestration flaked.
Sara Li: we need quick rollback of that single commit if flag kill doesn't fully suppress traffic. prefer single-commit revert + redeploy to avoid manual flag issues.
OncallBot: NOTE: escalation policy advanced to SRE primary -> infra lead. Paging infra-lead.
Matt O'Connor: attempting feature flag kill now via platform API: `POST /flags/kill` payload `{ "flag": "tokenizer-v2-rollout", "regions": ["eu-west-1"] }`
Matt O'Connor: response: 202 Accepted. Console shows partial success. some gateways still sending to canary variant.
Alex Ruiz: gateway routing caches on some edge nodes might be out of sync. invalidation command `infractl purge-routing eu-west-1 --all` queued, running now.
Dee Patel: preparing revert: `git revert --no-commit a1b2c3d && git commit -m "revert: tokenizer-refactor (a1b2c3d)"` branch `hotfix/revert-a1b2c3d`. Will open PR and deploy as hotfix if flag kill isn't immediate.
Sara Li: timeline decision: if errors not <1% within 8 minutes, execute revert + canary redeploy. We should also open customer incident page and notify top-5 affected accounts.
Product Ops: drafting message for top-5 customers. will wait for confirmation before sending.
Matt O'Connor: metrics: 03:18 UTC error rate trending down to 6%, but still high. some egress nodes at 0% (good), others at 10-18% (bad).
OncallBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress. runbook step `kill-flag-or-revert` in progress.
Alex Ruiz: purge completed on 12/12 edge nodes; 6 nodes had stale routes and required manual restart of proxy service. restarted them; checking effect.
Dee Patel: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/3421 - merging hotfix now. CI green. deploying `hotfix/revert-a1b2c3d` to canary eu-west-1.
Sara Li: merging and watching. rolling to canary.
OncallBot: DeployBot: Started rollout `hotfix/revert-a1b2c3d` to eu-west-1 canary (10% traffic).
Matt O'Connor: good to see canary traffic routing to old tokenizer variant. watch logs.
Product Ops: updating incident page: short summary, affected endpoint, mitigation steps taken, ETA for full rollback if needed.
Dee Patel: canary result after revert: 03:27 UTC 5xx down to 0.7% in canary, cache miss rate back to ~3%.
Alex Ruiz: invalidation + revert fixed edge nodes too. global error rate back to baseline.
Sara Li: great. start gradual rollout or keep off? suggest pause rollout and mark `tokenizer-v2-rollout` as failed. Need postmortem and revert cherry-pick with test guard.
Dee Patel: agreed — pausing further rollout. I'll disable auto-rollout pipelines for this feature and add extra unit + integration checks for tokenization boundary cases.
Product Ops: notifying customers: sent targeted messages to top-5 impacted accounts, broad advisory to status page that issue resolved, root cause investigation in progress.
OncallBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: severity reduced to S1 -> S3, auto-incident-close timer started. Please file postmortem within 48h and attach the PR link and timeline.
Sara Li: filing initial incident notes now, will own postmortem. tagging Dee and Matt.
Dee Patel: will add remediation actions and tests.
Matt O'Connor: adding a short script to verify cache-key compat across tokenizer versions. pushing to infra tests.
Alex Ruiz: closing monitoring alerts and watching for regressions over next 24h.
Product Ops: final note: customer comms logged in the incident doc.
Sara Li: thanks everyone.
